title: Sink units and plumbing coordination
intro: Coordinate the sink, cabinet and service space using product/site data, while distinguishing furniture coordination from plumbing design and approval.
goals: Draw the sink below the top

sections.title: Draw the sink below the top
sections.text: Draw the bowl, rim, mounting arrangement and underside clips from the selected model/template. Compare the underside envelope with rails, hinges and drawers. Keep sink-body dimensions distinct from the worktop cut-out and reference both before fabrication.
sections.caption: The bowl envelope and cut-out are different.

sections.title: Coordinate the service envelope
sections.text: Overlay approved plumbing locations and routes onto the furniture section from a shared datum. Do not infer pipe sizes or gradients from cabinet geometry. Check drawers, bins, shelves and connection access; return conflicts for specialist review before altering a site route.
sections.caption: Coordination identifies conflicts; it does not replace plumbing design.

sections.title: Review access, protection and acceptance
sections.text: Show service access and removable parts. Coordinate water-exposed edges, joints and care with the relevant suppliers. Before concealment, obtain the specialist’s service inspection record and inspect furniture against its drawing. A finished front does not prove hidden services accepted.
sections.caption: Link service and furniture inspection records.

example.title: Worked case and decision
example.text: A moving waste bin intersects the approved drainage envelope. Review the bin product or furniture arrangement; any service alteration returns to the specialist before execution.
example.decision: Decision: coordinate the conflict before release.

quiz.question: How should a drawer/drain conflict be resolved?
options: Coordinate furniture and services with the specialist
quiz.explanation: The resolution must retain approved service requirements and access.

assignment.prompt: Submit a sink/service section, an access review, a conflict record and an acceptance hold point.
fields: Draw the sink below the top

faq.question: Does cabinet size determine drain diameter?
faq.answer: No. The specialist defines services; furniture coordinates space and access.
